name: Matsuyuki Kiri
source: Haruki's older cousin who he refers to as an older sister.  She looks after Ame and Haruki as a parental figure, and her work is what supports their household.  A sweet and gentle-mannered 'oneesan' character who is looking forward to Ame and Haruki getting together.
